notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Added 3 new upgrade types
Homing: Bullets start homing onto enemies. Homing range is increased with each level
Lifetime: Bullet's lifetime is increased by 40 % per level
Spectral: Bullets can pass through walls and pierce trough enemies

Fixed some bugs.
